definitions.explanation: A building where goods are manufactured or processed.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{工場|こうじょう}で{働|はたら}いています。
examples.english: My father works at a factory.

examples.japanese: この{車|くるま}は{日本|にほん}の{工場|こうじょう}で{作|つく}られました。
examples.english: This car was made at a factory in Japan.

examples.japanese: {工場|こうじょう}{見学|けんがく}に{行|い}きました。
examples.english: I went on a factory tour.

notes: 工場 combines 工 (work/craft) and 場 (place). The reading こうじょう is standard, but こうば is also used, especially for smaller workshops. 工場見学 (factory tours) are popular in Japan, especially for food and beverage companies.
